guidebook.intro: Kilimo hufuata mvua, na majirani husaidiana. Jifunze kusema “kwa ajili ya mtu” kwa Kiingereza.

tips.title: When the rain starts
body: **Mvua ikianza** ni **when the rain starts**. Baada ya **when** kwa jambo la kesho, Kiingereza hutumia wakati uliopo, si **will**: **We’ll plant when it rains.**
Vivyo hivyo na **after** na **before**: **We’ll eat after we finish.**

tips.title: Kwa ajili ya: for, to, me
body: Kiswahili huongeza **-i-/-e-** ndani ya kitenzi (**-pikia**, **-letea**). Kiingereza hutumia neno: **I’m cooking for you** (ninakupikia), **farm for him** (mlimie).
Kwa **bring**, **give** na **show**, mtu huja moja kwa moja: **Bring me the hoe** (niletee jembe), **Give her the seeds.**

culture.title: Shamba
body: Kiingereza cha Afrika Mashariki husema **shamba** pia, lakini Uingereza husema **farm** au **field**. Mkulima ni **farmer**, mavuno ni **harvest**.
